abilities.name: Crushing Slam
abilities.description: Short cone smash, heaviest straight ahead. Melee range — ignores cover.

abilities.name: Bulwark
abilities.description: Raise a 30-point shield for this turn. The classic answer to a predicted burst.

abilities.name: Ram Charge
abilities.description: Charge in a straight line: EVERY enemy the path crosses takes 23 damage and is knocked back 1 square (losing their Move). A wall of a man going through a crowd.

abilities.name: Chain Hook
abilities.description: Hook the first enemy in a line: 23 damage, dragged 2 squares toward Bastion, Move cancelled. Sets up next turn's Slam.

ultimate.name: Fortress Protocol
ultimate.description: For 2 turns: 50 shield, Unstoppable, and Might. Walk at them. (100 energy)
